# Azahar VR on a PC: fonts

The VR panels and keyboard draw with Noto Sans. The Steam Frame finds it in `/usr/share/fonts/noto`;
a PC has no such folder, so the PC packages carry these two files in `art` beside the program.

| File | From | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NotoSans-Regular.ttf` | Noto Sans 2.015 (SteamOS `noto-fonts 1:2026.03.01-1`, the Frame's own file) | `478c558ea716033cd60c03438f628dfa75694dcf6b5f6d505a2f05fd2b4f3823` |
| `NotoSans-Bold.ttf` | the same | `1df075a380fc7cb898acf64c1f7b3b4dd780de3caa860178bf929de35817a913` |

Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1, in `NotoSans-OFL.txt`.
